system.description: The target becomes a large black oak with Protection 8; after this protection, only one fifth of damage harms it. It recovers 1 HP per hour, feeds on water from the soil and sunlight, and is immune to demons’ attacks and abilities. Once per day, it can attempt a Situation Value 6 test (Psyche) to remove a curse or demonic infection. It can return to its normal form at any time; if it dies in this form, it remains a black oak.
system.summary: Transforms the target into a resilient tree.
